$comment: Every direct dependency must be listed here with a reason. A new entry needs maintainer review: it must not send data off the device (no analytics, ads, crash reporting, remote fonts, CDNs).

packages.idb: Thin promise wrapper around IndexedDB (web storage). No network code.
packages.@capacitor/filesystem: Encrypted photo files in app-private storage; camera leftover cleanup. Its deprecated downloadFile() does network I/O and is banned by privacy-check.
packages.@capacitor-community/sqlite: Local SQLite on Android. Stores ciphertext only.
packages.@capacitor/local-notifications: On-device scheduled notifications (no push server). Reviewed: no network code in web or Android sources.
packages.recharts: Lab trend charts. Reviewed: no network code in recharts or its runtime deps (RTK Query's fetch module is never imported).
